children: Reliance Industries Ltd Sponsored GDR 144A (NSE:RELIANCE) raised Rs12,000 crore via 1.2M unsecured NCDs and accepted Rs125bn in five‑year bonds at 7.47%, while facing fuel‑tax exposure, exploring a 300MW BSMR nuclear SPV and expanding Jio’s Canva Pro tie‑up to boost digital reach.
: RELIANCE issued 1.2M unsecured NCDs (PPD Series Q) of ₹100,000 each, raising ₹12,000 crore via private placement (base ₹10,000 crore, Green Shoe ₹2,500 crore); NCDs to list on BSE and NSE
: RELIANCE accepted bids worth ₹125 billion for a five-year rupee bond with a 7.47% annual coupon — its first rupee bond issue since November 2023.
: RELIANCE (GDR 144A): Large refining and export exposure makes the stock most exposed to government cut in Special Additional Excise Duty on petrol, diesel (₹5/litre diesel cut) and ATF.
: RELIANCE is reportedly in talks to join a private SPV for India’s 300MW BSMR-300 project; plan seeks ~Rs 30 crore/MW capex, RFP expected, potential scale-up toward India’s 2047 nuclear target.
: RELIANCE: Jio partners with Canva to offer one-year free Canva Pro/Pro Lite via MyJio app in India, delivering AI design tools in local languages to millions of users.
